name.description: Name of the sheet. Must be unique, not empty, at most 256 characters, without the characters <>/\":;?*|,=`.

index.description: Position of the sheet in the sheet list, starting at 1.

sheetDetails.description: Details of the sheet: logicalId, name and index.

size.description: Paper size name of the sheet. Valid names depend on the drawing standard; 'Custom' requires width and height.

formatReference.description: Drawing template applied as the sheet format; null removes the template. Not exported.

format.description: Name of the drawing template applied to the sheet, or 'Custom' when none is applied. Read-only; formatReference sets the template.

width.description: Width of the sheet in drawing units. A width different from the paper size requires size 'Custom'.

height.description: Height of the sheet in drawing units. A height different from the paper size requires size 'Custom'.

includeBorder.description: Whether the sheet has a border with zones.

zones.description: Zones of the sheet border. Exported only when the border is included.

horizontal.description: Number of horizontal zones; an even number from 0 to 20.

vertical.description: Number of vertical zones; an even number from 0 to 20.

startZone.description: Corner the zone numbering starts from.

reference.description: Reference id of the model the sheet refers to. Read-only; referenceDetails changes the reference.

boundingBoxPoints.description: Bounding box of the sheet's physical paper/border region, independent of the position of any views, annotations or other entities on the sheet.
